rationale: Five-step: (1) requirement questioned: 'pnpm test fully green locally' is not a trust-chain control; CI is the single gate (AISDLC-726) and DEC-0202 already waives a test that passes alone and whose sources the diff does not touch. bin-invocation.test.ts and usage-views.test.ts are the DEC-0200 cli-usage family. (2) delete: nothing (no new rule; this names the carrier DEC-0202 lacked). (3) simplify: the sanctioned carrier NOW is the developer return: re-run the two files alone, confirm the diff touches neither them nor their sources, report verifications.test as 'skipped' (the only non-failing honest status in parse-dev-return) with the two test names, the passes-alone evidence and the not-ok lines in the developer notes and the PR body; next-step then proceeds to reviewers, sign, push. (4) accelerate: no extra round trip per flake. (5) automate: a 'waived' verification status with mandatory evidence fields in parse-dev-return is filed as AISDLC-864. fix-flakes is a separate task, not a blocker; push-only is wrong because nothing is reviewed yet. Class (a): reversible, CI still gates, no control loosened beyond DEC-0202.
